g.text: NEWSLETTER
Department of Earth, Planetary, and Space Sciences
University of California, Los Angeles
595 Charles Young Drive East, Box 951567
Los Angeles, CA 90095-1567
WHAT'S CHANGED
The newsletter is now digital.
For decades this arrived as a printed booklet. Beginning
with the 2025–2026 issue, it lives online — no page limit,
photographs in full color, and room for far more of our
students, alumni, and faculty than paper ever allowed.
What hasn’t changed: it’s still annual, still edited here in
the department, still the newsletter you’ve read for years.
SCAN OR VISIT
epss.ucla.edu/newsletter
Point your phone’s camera at the square
— no app needed. Or type the address
into any web browser.
Prefer paper? Call (310) 825-3880 or email info@epss.ucla.edu
and we will mail you a printed copy of this issue.
Jonathan Aurnou
Department Chair, Earth, Planetary & Space Sciences
